lenses.name: Cycling network
lenses.description: Explicit cycling-infrastructure kilometers per 10,000 residents. Segment lengths are attributed to current communes, split where a segment crosses a commune boundary, then population-weighted by map hex. OSM coverage completeness varies by territory.

lenses.name: Protected cycling
lenses.description: Physically protected or off-carriageway cycling-infrastructure kilometers per 10,000 residents: pistes cyclables, voies vertes, bus-bike corridors, mixed pedestrian/cycle facilities, protected shoulders and goulotte lanes. OSM coverage completeness varies.
